apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. PT's overhead press restriction is a medical constraint, not a programming preference — "I know my body" doesn't override it. I won't add overhead pressing to Wednesday.

That restriction is logged in memory already (rotator cuff tendinopathy, PT ban). Wednesday's Upper Body Strength stays as-is, loading rows/pulldowns/pulls instead of presses. If you want to push the shoulder, bring it up with your PT — I'll program around whatever they clear.
